text: Composes fugazibase's six published tables (shows, locations, durations, discography, songs, bands) Repeatr's already-saved data/*.rda objects ("Derived-cleaned" tier produced Repeatr_1, already includes price/currency split Brazilian/NA-standardized subdivision values) inst/extdata/fls_venue_geocoding_v2.csv directly - re-derivation new business logic, just selecting, renaming, joining columns Repeatr already computed. Also runs basic integrity checks (missing/duplicate id columns) table just written, aborting export fail. Writes table data/*.rda (lazy-loadable) file directly local fugazibase checkout. commit push anything checkout - review commit fugazibase's changes separately. Excludes anything joined/summarized/modeled (e.g. xray, duration_summary, Repeatr1, everything Repeatr_2 onward) copyrighted free-text show notes (fls_notes, scraped Fugazi Live Series site - see fugazibase's LICENSE) - see vignette("Data-Provenance") full tier catalogue.

title: Tags data — fls_tags
text: Derived-cleaned. Parsed Repeatr_1 (via fls_tags_importer) raw inst/extdata/fls_tags.txt kid3 MP3-tag export; raw tag's name field renamed title read time. underlying track/album/song names sourced Fugazi Live Series site, personal data - Alex Mitrani applied consistent album-name format handful one-track-title corrections top (see "process tags data" section Repeatr_1). raw album tag text (YYYYMMDD Venue, City, State, Country) used internally parse venue/city/subdivision/country couple mistagged-track filters derive fls_tags_show, fields (album ) dropped saving, since parsing counting commas silently misparses whenever venue city name contains comma (e.g. Ypsilanti, Flint, Eau Claire, Osaka), shows_data (joined via gid) sole authoritative source . Exported (minus date - join fugazibase's shows gid instead - seconds, duplicated duration; track converted character integer) fugazibase's durations table export_fugazibase_data.

what: Scrape an up-to-date Fugazi Live Series dataset, including new shows — scrape_fls_shows
title: Scrape an up-to-date Fugazi Live Series dataset, including new shows — scrape_fls_shows
text: Discovers full, current list shows directly Fugazi Live Series listing pages (https://www.dischord.com/fugazi_live_series?page=N), auto-detecting many listing pages currently exist site's pagination widget rather assuming fixed number - picks shows added since last scrape without manual bookkeeping. target show scrapes one detail page returns single tidy row combining information fugotcha.csv (show date, venue, door price, attendance, recorded , mastered , original source, tracklist) plus sound quality played-, previously required separate scraping passes (see scrape_fls_data.R). default, shows already present existing_data scraped, routine re-runs cheap polite site. Set update_existing = TRUE re-scrape everything discovered. listing pages also show Available Yes/flag per show (whether recording downloadable), captured free discovering gids. detect_changes = TRUE (default), show already file tracklist yet, whose flag since turned "Yes", added scrape targets alongside brand-new shows - catches shows tracklist (usually sound quality/played ) added fact, without visiting every existing show's page. can catch changes visible listing page (recording newly appearing); catch e.g. corrected door price sound quality rating changed show already available - use update_existing = TRUE (optionally gids target specific shows) refresh . fugazi-live--access (FLS0000) detail page like show actually standing -access download bundle, show - always excluded scrape targets.

code: scrape_fls_shows(   existing_data = NULL,   update_existing = FALSE,   detect_changes = TRUE,   gids = NULL,   max_shows = Inf,   max_listing_pages = Inf,   sleepseconds = 2,   mycsvfilename = NULL )

title: Scrape an up-to-date Fugazi Live Series dataset, including new shows — scrape_fls_shows
text: existing_data Path CSV used determine gids already known, new shows get scraped. Accepts either tidy format function produces (must gid column) legacy headerless fugotcha.csv format (gid first column). Defaults fugotcha.csv shipped package. Ignored update_existing = TRUE. update_existing TRUE, scrape every discovered (supplied) gid regardless existing_data. Default FALSE. detect_changes TRUE (default), also re-scrape shows already existing_data tracklist file whose listing-page Available flag turned "Yes", since means recording added last scrape. applies listing-page discovery (.e. gids supplied) ignored update_existing = TRUE (already re-scrapes everything). gids Optional character vector specific gids scrape, bypassing listing-page discovery entirely. Useful testing refreshing handful known shows. max_shows Maximum number shows scrape. Set low number testing. Defaults Inf (cap). max_listing_pages Maximum number listing pages page discovery. Set low number testing. Defaults Inf (pages everything site's pagination widget reports). Ignored gids supplied. sleepseconds Seconds wait every request (listing pages show pages), stay polite site. Default 2. mycsvfilename Optional filename write resulting data frame CSV (headered, UTF-8). NULL (default) result returned, written disk.
